identifiability_assessment.classification: ALPHA: NOT EMPIRICALLY IDENTIFIABLE FROM APPROVED DATA
identifiability_assessment.reason: Approved datasets supply only static flight route records (carrier arcs) and country populations. They contain zero passenger counts, zero travel frequencies, zero per-capita mobility rates, and zero infected passenger numbers. Alpha is collinear with unobserved passenger flux and interchangeable with local beta adjustments.
identifiability_assessment.retraction: The previous classification 'FULLY IDENTIFIABLE & IMPLEMENTABLE' is explicitly RETRACTED. The mathematical formulation is computationally evaluable under explicit assumptions, but alpha CANNOT be empirically estimated or identified from the approved data.

1_route_connectivity_information.variables: C_ij (route count), P_ij (outbound normalized route share)
1_route_connectivity_information.nature: Topological structure of scheduled air network; dimensionless branching probabilities.

2_human_mobility_information.nature: Physical volume of human bodies traversing borders per unit time.

3_infection_importation_rate.nature: Absolute physical flux of infectious individuals crossing national borders.

4_international_coupling_strength.nature: Fraction of transmission hazard attributable to international contact vs domestic contact.

project_plan_audit.conclusion: No explicit definition, formula, or numerical value exists in Plan.pdf for alpha, coupling strength, international transmission coefficient, mobility coefficient, travel rate, or importation rate.

scenarios.epidemiological_meaning: Zero international transmission hazard; exact single-country SEIRD mechanics v2 baseline.
0.1% of effective transmission hazard originates from international flight connectivity; high border friction / low traveler mixing.
1.0% of effective transmission hazard originates from international flight connectivity; typical air travel connectivity benchmark.
5.0% of effective transmission hazard originates from international flight connectivity; major international transit hubs / high importation stress.

sensitivity_framework.operational_rule: Numerical scenario benchmarks (0.0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05) are operational sensitivity assumptions for comparative analysis; they must NOT be claimed to represent measured real-world travel.
